Week 1 · Lesson 3 · Day 3 — Step 1

Welcome

Welcome. Today you will meet two women at a women-only English centre. Bienvenue. Aujourd'hui, vous allez rencontrer deux femmes dans un centre d'anglais réservé aux femmes.

Look at the Situation

Look. Nadia is joining an English class. Regardez. Nadia rejoint un cours d'anglais.

Watch and Listen

Watch and listen to the conversation. Regardez et écoutez la conversation.

Fatima: Good morning. What is your first name?

Nadia: My first name is Nadia.

Fatima: What is your last name?

Nadia: My last name is Hassan.

Fatima: How do you spell Nadia?

Nadia: N-A-D-I-A.
